info.title: ArcFlow RuoYi native ArcFlow overlay
info.description: Checked-in contract, not a deployed Swagger endpoint. RuoYi owns JWT sessions, permissions and host error behavior. Nine sequential handlers plus twelve fixed travel graph handlers. No Basic authentication, generic graph selector, quote source, or added login route.

servers.description: Relative to the configured RuoYi host; frontend dev-api/prod-api are proxy prefixes.

get.summary: capabilities in the selected structured business graph workspace
get.description: Fixed native travel-graph schema 6. Numeric authenticated RuoYi actor, live native permission and shared domain checks are all required. Runtime reads remain applicant or selected frozen-path participants; publication and administrator permission do not bypass task assignment. Authoring uses CAS; submission and decision require exactly one valid command key. Null graph fields are preserved in AjaxResult.data.

200.description: Current graph result. Preview does not write; decisions and submissions replay without duplicate side effects.

403.description: Inactive/deleted native actor, missing live native permission, authoring permission, selected-path visibility, or task assignment check failed. Native authentication failures remain owned by the RuoYi host.

503.description: Storage unavailable; no change confirmed. Refresh before retrying.

default.description: Unhandled framework exceptions have no uniform envelope guarantee.

ruoyiBearer.description: Typical native RuoYi Authorization: Bearer token. Obtained and validated by the separately configured host, not ArcFlow. No token endpoint is declared here.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one value when present; case-sensitive, no comma-combined value. Same actor/key/normalized intent replays current state; changed intent conflicts.

RequiredIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequiredIdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one value when present; case-sensitive, no comma-combined value. Same actor/key/normalized intent replays current state; changed intent conflicts.

ClientHeader.name: X-Arcflow-Client
ClientHeader.description: Required for every unsafe method by SecurityConfig.
